thread:
Priya: heads-up: onboarding magnetY14b-q4 brought up a deterministic KV mismatch after long system prompts. repro always flips around token 16384. can someone sanity-check?

Leo: thanks — do you have the exact cmdline + a tiny log excerpt?

Priya: sure. running on a dev-pool A100, command:```./infer_shard --model magnetY14b-q4 --prefill tests/huge_sys_prompt.txt --prefill-tokens 16500 --kv-out /tmp/kvdump.bin --warmstart=1 --trace=kv_index```log snippet:```[2026-03-19T09:11:02Z] prefill_count=16500 kv_len=16500
[2026-03-19T09:11:12Z] kv_write idx=16383 -> slot=0x7f9c...
[2026-03-19T09:11:12Z] kv_read  idx=16383 -> slot=0x8a2d...  # mismatch detected
[2026-03-19T09:11:12Z] diverged_at=16384
```

Thomas: 16384 is another power-of-two boundary, looks like our tiling window or rotary-phase scaling toggles at that size. did you try float32 or disabling the tile-compact path?

Priya: quick matrix: float32=ok, q4=diverges @16384, q8=int8 also diverges but at 16290 in one run (weird). when I force `--no-compact-tiling` the q4 run stays coherent, so that points at compact tiling + quant mapping.

Nina: can you attach the kvdump + a minimal repro harness? also run with `ROPE_MODE=wrap` vs `ROPE_MODE=scale` (we have both in the runtime). if wrap avoids the mismatch, rescale is the suspect.

Priya: uploaded branch `eng-ml/onboard/magnetY-kv16384` with `tests/kv_repro/kv_16384.py` and small kv snapshot (50KB) to the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rlib/pull/4321 . reproducer supports `--rope-mode` and `--quant-mode`.

Leo: nice. I'll queue a batch of runs across quant modes + tile settings. can you also run with `--trace-rope-idx` so we can diff rotary indices across the boundary?

Priya: good call. added `--trace-rope-idx` to harness. sample diff shows index wrap at boundary:```rope_idx[16382]=0x0f0a
rope_idx[16383]=0x0f0b
rope_idx[16384]=0x0003  # unexpected reset
```

Thomas: ohhh that reset looks wrong. probably an integer overflow during tile stride computation when crossing from base-tiles -> compact-tiles. that would explain why float32 takes a different path and doesn't hit the quantized memcpy path.

Nina: if it's an overflow, q4 vs int8 might show different symptoms because of different packing/stride sizes. please run a tiny kernel trace with `KTRACE=1` and I'll inspect the tiling math.

infra-bot: CI job `eng-ml/magnetY-kv16384-sanity` started by Leo  job id 100211. Artifacts will be available in ~45m.

Leo: action items: 1) Priya attach full kvdump + harness (done), 2) Thomas to run kernel trace and post offsets, 3) Nina to diff rope indices and tiling math, 4) me to gate a CI test so PR blocks. Aim: quick mitigation in dedicated if it's a small math bug.

Priya: quick follow-up: q4 with `ROPE_MODE=wrap` does not diverge. q4 with `ROPE_MODE=scale` diverges at 16384. so rescale path + compact-tiling interaction is top suspect.

Thomas: will post kernel trace by EOD. if it's a stride integer bug, fix is likely a single cast change + a unit test.

Priya: thanks all, marking this ENG-ML-2217. please comment on PR with any reproductions so CI artifacts stay attached.
